description: Use when the venue owner asks to add new products to their own menu. Put each product in an existing category (category_id from get_my_menu) or in a new one (new_category_name; reused if a category with that name already exists). Keep names and prices exactly as the owner says; never invent descriptions or allergens. Up to 50 products per call. Two steps: call first without confirm to get the preview (nothing is saved), show it to the owner, and only after they agree call again with confirm: true. New texts are translated automatically. Requires the owner to connect their PRENOTO account. Reply in the owner's language.

confirm.description: false or omitted: preview only. true: save, only after the owner agreed to the preview.

new_category_name.description: Use instead of category_id to create a category.

price.description: In the venue currency, without symbol. 0 only if the owner has no price yet.

station.description: Only for a new category: kitchen for food, bar for drinks. Default kitchen.

venue_id.description: Optional. Only needed when the account manages several venues (see list_my_venues).
